title: feat(sdk): add 3D generation, model status and speech timestamps
author: Saauf

gist.summary: SDK 5.1.0-alpha.17 adds `model3d()` for binary 3D output with server-provided MIME types, keyless URLs, reference images, and discovery through `models("3d")`. It reuses `videoTimeout` for 3D requests rather than adding a separate setting or decoder. Typed `modelStatus()` returns model status data. Timestamped speech returns raw audio and alignments plus normalized word timings; audio remains usable when timings are missing. The release also adds exports, examples, regression tests, README documentation, and a changelog entry. Drjacky and tomdacatto contributed to the timeout approach, and tomdacatto documented PLY and speech testing.
